story_type: parachute rescue to a ship at sea
hook: Four rescuers jumped 780 nautical miles from land
narration: Four rescuers jumped out of this plane, seven hundred eighty nautical miles from California.
A crew member aboard the cargo ship Grand Vega had a suspected stroke.
An Air National Guard plane flew out with pararescuemen and a boat.
They jump with a boat package, a small inflatable boat, to reach a ship at sea.
They climbed aboard the ship and stabilized the patient.
Next day, helicopters flew out, refueling from a plane midair.
outcome: The patient was hoisted and flown to Stanford Hospital.
title: Parachuted 780 nautical miles out
description:
California Air National Guard pararescuemen from the 129th Rescue Wing parachuted with a boat package to the cargo ship Grand Vega, about 780 nautical miles west of California, to stabilize a crew member with a suspected stroke, Sept. 2025.

Footage: U.S. Air National Guard video by 129th Rescue Wing Public Affairs, via DVIDS: https://www.dvidshub.net/video/977862/129rqw-conduct-long-range-overwater-rescue
